label: Diagram 1.1
caption: Diagram 1.1 Measurement of clear opening width of external and internal doors
description: This is a plan view showing a doorway between two walls, with a single door leaf drawn in its fully open position as a vertical line on the left. A curved arc, representing the swing path of the door, runs from the closed position at the bottom of the opening up to the open door leaf. At the top of the open leaf, two small projecting edges are marked c on the left and d on the right. A horizontal dashed line spans the bottom of the opening, labelled a at its left end and b at its right end. Below this, a dimension line with arrowheads at each end is annotated 'distance a-b = clear opening width'. To the right, a Key lists: a inside face of door (when open); b inside edge of door frame or stop; c leading edge; d following edge. A Notes section states: 1. Handles, other door furniture and weatherboards may be ignored when measuring clear opening width. The green title bar at the bottom reads: Diagram 1.1 Measurement of clear opening width of external and internal doors.
